history.summary: The 'cheapness' is fabricated from a regional baseline with zero project transactions — and a real transaction check shows the $1,624 psf asking is ABOVE Primedge's recent resale range, so it's priced rich, not cheap.
history.rating_rationale: The algo's -16.0% age-adj premium is unreliable: appreciation_source is regional_baseline with appreciation_txns=0 and psf_cohort_txns=null, meaning there were no project comps behind the score. Verified data contradicts it — Primedge's last-12-month transactions ran $1,353-1,602 psf (avg ~$1,469), so the $1,624 psf / $760-770k ask is at the top of and above the project's recent range. Paying above recent comps for a 474 sqft 1+1 shoebox in a 36-unit boutique on a busy Geylang road, with no dated catalyst, is the opposite of the value the score implies. Freehold is not a forward edge per the priors. Score 1000=789 is not supported by the unit-level evidence.
red_flags: Appreciation from regional_baseline with 0 project txns and null cohort — no real comparable behind the score
Asking $1,624 psf exceeds the project's recent transaction range ($1,353-1,602, avg ~$1,469) — priced above market
474 sqft 1+1 shoebox in a 36-unit boutique on a busy Geylang road — thin liquidity, vice-belt address
No dated MRT/zone/en-bloc catalyst to justify the premium entry
catalysts: Walkable to Dakota/Aljunied MRT; freehold tenure (livability only, not a forward edge)
